The lighting is bright natural daylight, highlighting the smooth texture of the product and her facial expressions. (3) The scene shifts to the woman standing in front of a brick wall with Disney-themed signage. She gestures towards the camera. The background shows park visitors walking by in a slightly blurred depth of field, maintaining focus on her. The woman's hands are seen gesturing in a web-slinging motion. The environment is darker with artificial blue and red lighting. (10) The final scene returns to the woman at night, illuminated by warm artificial park lights. She wears the Baby Yoda headband and smiles at the camera. She performs a rubbing motion on her underarm and smells her hand, expressing a playful and satisfied look.
